name: Ikunyuushu ~Genjuuya Advance Episode~
original_name: 育乳種 ～幻獣屋アドバンストエピソード～
source:
Main character is a young man who lives in a mansion in the suburbs of the Highlandy Republic capital. The mansion used to be an enterprise to provide girl escorts from aquatic tribes, and protagonist starts to study aquatic culture. One day a hunter appears and asks protagonist to take care of a mermaid. That was the first encounter with Ryuka.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-july-2001-cosmos-no-sora-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名年轻男子，住在高地共和国首都郊外的一座宅邸里。这座宅邸曾经营为水族部落提供女伴的企业，主角开始学习水族文化。一天，一名猎人出现，请主角照顾一条人鱼。那是他与琉花的初次相遇。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-july-2001-cosmos-no-sora-ni.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
